label: Aarhus University: IB results and programme documents

milestones.label: AU: quota 2 qualifications and supporting documents
milestones.note: Relevant qualifications must be completed and documented by this deadline; they are not accepted at the general July document deadline.

milestones.label: AU: general final documents; same-year IB online results exception
milestones.note: Upload other evidence by noon. Same-year IB results arriving later are accessed through authorised IB results service code 000150. Paying applicants instead need final educational documents by 15 March noon.

milestones.label: AU: confirm your student place in MyApplication
milestones.note: AU publishes 3 August without an intake year; confirm the deadline in the 2027 offer.

milestones.label: AU: final evidence for conditional supplementary courses
milestones.note: If AU offers conditional admission, register the summer supplementary course or English test by 5 July and document completion by this date. At most two supplementary courses after 5 July; later grades cannot enter the quota 2 GPA.

submissionItems.label: Authorise AU to access your final IB results online (code 000150)
submissionItems.note: Tell your IB coordinator and retain the registration receipt. AU does not publish a separate dated results-service registration deadline; arrange access before results are released. The 5 July general document deadline does not exclude same-year non-paying IB candidates.

submissionItems.label: Upload a completed IB diploma with the application
submissionItems.note: Retake candidates upload original Course Results, state the retake and arrange online results access. AU’s pages read do not publish a separate predicted-grade deadline; follow the portal and admissions instructions for available school records.

submissionItems.label: Signed documentation of quota 2 activities and qualifications
submissionItems.note: State activity dates, scope/hours and duties, with issuing authority signature or stamp. The national route’s generic July quota-2 checklist date does not apply at AU.

supplementarySteps: Apply through optagelse.dk by 15 March noon, including the signed signature page where required.
Annual dates are provisional for autumn 2027. Check AU’s own 2027 calendar and individual offer.
The general national checklist is supplemented here: AU quota 2 documents are due 15 March; IB results are accessed online; the reply date is 3 August.
